text:
maya: quick sync: iterating on dark theme for the console. primary asks: improve chart line visibility at 1px, pick a better inline-code contrast, and reconcile legend styling for stacked vs. overlaid charts.
andre: thanks. can you paste the latest tokens? want to compare against the toolkit.
jordan: also flagging that the sparkline micro-charts are practically invisible on small displays. we should avoid relying only on saturation.
maya: current tokens: 
```
--bg: #08090a
--surface-1: #0e1012
--surface-2: #141617
--muted: #97a0a6
--success: #66e0b0
--primary: #7fb0ff
--code-bg: #0b0d0f
--code-fg: #d6e6f3
```
andre: contrast-bot will complain about `code-fg` vs `code-bg`. try `#e9f2fb` or nudge bg to #0d0f11.
contrast-bot: auto-check: `#d6e6f3` on `#0b0d0f` = 4.1:1 (below 4.5 for normal text). Recommendation: `#e9f2fb` => 4.6:1.
jordan: for lines: proposal is to use slightly higher chroma for line strokes and keep areas 30% desaturated. e.g., `--line-primary: #6ea8ff`, `--area-primary: rgba(110,168,255,0.22)` and add a 1px soft white halo at 10% opacity when on surface-2.
tara: for color-blind users we should also map error-rate to pattern (dashed line) in addition to red/pink differences.
maya: good call. also copy tweak: Settings > Model "Top-p" helper text currently reads "higher = more tokens kept" 0 maybe change to "higher = broader token distribution (more variety)"?
andre: +1. shorter: "Higher = broader output distribution".
jordan: legend treatment: options: A) solid semi-opaque pill behind legend items, B) one translucent strip behind the whole legend. I prefer B for compact dashboards.
maya: B sounds right. try `background: rgba(6,8,10,0.78)` for the strip. contrast-bot: run it.
contrast-bot: auto-check: `rgba(6,8,10,0.78)` on `--surface-2` => pass 6.8:1.
andre: small CSS snippet for focus ring tweak: 
```css
button:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(127,176,255,0.16); outline: none; }
```
jordan: that looks better — bigger halo & slightly stronger alpha. test keyboard nav across dense sidebars.
maya: action list: 1) andre to post updated tokens + run color-a11y script (due today). 2) jordan to prototype chart B with halo + pattern for error-rate (mock by tomorrow AM). 3) tara to update copy strings in the i18n file. 4) me to add a short note in /docs/accessibility explaining the code contrast choice and link contrast outputs.
tara: will do copy changes and leave comments for localization team.
contrast-bot: reminder: use `design-kit color-a11y --report` after edits.
maya: thanks all 0 ping me if you want me to pair on the mock. :paintbrush:
